Visitor customizes details/summary disclosure elements

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

final class LocalVisitor_VisitorDetailsSummaryCustom: HtmlVisitorProtocol {
    func visitSummary(_ ctx: HtmlToMarkdown.NodeContext, _ text: String) -> VisitResult { return .custom(field0: "[EXPANDABLE] \(text)") }
}

let _visitorHandle_options = makeHtmlVisitorHandle(LocalVisitor_VisitorDetailsSummaryCustom())
let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJsonWithVisitor("{}", _visitorHandle_options)
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<details><summary>Click to expand</summary><p>This content is initially hidden.</p><p>But can be revealed by the user.</p></details>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
